Requested before merge:

1. `crates/ui/src/look_at.rs:38`: Calculate the face normal with `setup_align::view_pose`, as picking and drawing do. `pick::first_hit_f` picks in the active setup's frame. This code transforms the picked triangle with `model::transform_of`, which omits the setup alignment. For a part turned 90 degrees about X, a local +Z face is shown along Y. This function still returns a Z normal. Thus, "Look at a face" does not face the clicked face. Add a test with a rotated setup and assert the normal in the shown frame. The current test uses an unaligned box. This code comes from parent #2835 and is still in this PR's diff.
2. `crates/app/src/view.rs:54`: Run the reached heavy lane on the final head and add its results to the PR body. `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run` selects all app heavy targets because `app::view` changed. The body says the heavy lanes did not run. Upstream `AGENTS.md:601` requires the reached tests to pass before the PR becomes ready. This review did not run them.

Merge commit: `470246c58` (`Merge remote-tracking branch 'origin/main' into issue/2834-display-quality-shadow-ao`). The cause of the conflicts is #2931 ("Wireframe, see-through", d5621be06).

Conflicted files and resolutions:

1. `crates/ui/src/draw_list.rs` (`plan_with`): this PR's face pass choice stays (`FacesDepthOnly`, `FacesOccluded` or `Faces`). Main's `!display.sees_through()` check now encloses the push of that pass.
2. `crates/ui/src/draw_list_tests.rs`: both sides stay. These are the three #2834 tests and main's `see_through_wireframe_draws_each_edge_and_no_face`.
3. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests.rs`: both module lines stay (`mod display_quality;` and `mod see_through;`).

Semantic edits. The PR body asks for these three edits. They make the new mode a wireframe mode for this PR:

- `crates/ui/src/draw_list.rs:148` and `:159`: `wireframe` is `display.is_wireframe()`. See-through draws no face pass, no ground shadow and no occluded face pass.
- `crates/ui/src/shade_cache.rs:155`: `collect` uses `state.display.is_wireframe()`. See-through builds no shade data.
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/display_menu.rs:119`: the two switches are disabled in the two wireframe modes. The tooltip is now "The wireframe modes do not draw this. Select a shaded mode."

There is no other comparison of display modes in this PR's code that needed a change. `view_pass.rs` and `viewport.rs` already use `is_wireframe()`.

Tests added or extended:

- `draw_list::tests::the_ground_shadow_pass_draws_after_the_model_and_before_the_stock`: now also checks see-through.
- `draw_list::tests::the_occlusion_pass_takes_the_model_face_slot`: now also checks see-through. With the two switches on, the draw list is `[Edges, Edges, Region]`.
- `egui_app::tests::display_quality::wireframe_disables_the_two_switches_and_keeps_their_values`: now checks the two wireframe modes.
- New: `shade_cache::tests::the_wireframe_modes_build_no_shade_data`.
- `layout_window_display_menu` merged without a conflict. It lists the entries of the two PRs in the order of the menu.
- `ViewPrefs` merged without a conflict. #2931 added no field. A view file from either PR alone still loads.

The latest review on head `470246c58` requests no code change. The PR now conflicts with `main` (`35d65e03b`) again. The cause is #2958 ("wide overlay lines, with MSAA", `0cd1a634f`, `bdea342b6`).

A merge of `main` gives five conflicts:

- `crates/app/src/view.rs`
- `crates/ui/src/state_view.rs`
- `crates/ui/src/viewport.rs`
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/display_menu.rs`
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/display_quality.rs` (add/add)

Most of these keep both sides. One hunk changes the same logic on the two sides, so the fixer did not guess:

- On `main`, `viewport.rs` builds each pipeline through `pipes::build(..., samples)`. The default is 4x MSAA. `set_samples` builds the pipelines again for a new count.
- In this PR, `ShadePass::new` (`crates/ui/src/shade_pass.rs:161`) builds the shadow and occlusion pipelines with `wgpu::MultisampleState::default()`, which is 1 sample.
- A 1-sample pipeline in a 4-sample render pass is a wgpu validation error. The result is a crash in the viewport when a user sets a switch on.

The fix must give `ShadePass` the sample count, and `set_samples` must build `ShadePass` again. This is new render logic. The GPU tests cannot verify it on this machine, because no graphics adapter is available.

Other items to merge:

- `display_menu.rs`: the two sides each add a `quality` function to the Graphics group. The menu must keep the two sets of rows under different function names.
- `display_quality.rs`: the two sides each add a test module with this name. One of the modules must get a new name.

The menu screenshot that the last refresh comment asked for is still open. The merged menu will also have the #2958 rows.

The branch is not changed. A session with a GPU must do this refresh.

Second refresh by the maintainer's clear-out order. This is a merge of `main` after PR #2989 merged (wide anti-aliased overlay lines and MSAA, 3c761b5bb). #2989 changed the same renderer code as this PR.

Commits:

- `f8d4e8a4a`: merge of `origin/main`.
- `02638abe4`: a clippy fix in the new test (`as_chunks` in place of `chunks_exact`).

Conflicted files and resolutions:

1. `crates/app/src/view.rs`: `ViewPrefs` keeps the two fields of each PR:
   - `ground_shadow` and `ambient_occlusion` (#2834)
   - `line_width` and `antialias` (#2989)

   Each field has its serde default, so a view file from each PR alone still loads.
2. `crates/ui/src/state_view.rs`: the load and `persist_view` carry the four fields. `State::effects`, `select_line_width` and `select_antialias` stay.
3. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/display_menu.rs`: the two PRs each had a function `quality`. The function of #2989 is now `lines`. The order in the Graphics group is:
   - the projection
   - "Line width" and "Anti-aliasing" (#2989)
   - a separator
   - "Performance", "Quality", "Ground shadow" and "Ambient occlusion" (#2834)
4. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/display_quality.rs`: the two PRs added this file. It is now one module with all 13 tests (8 from #2834, 5 from #2989).
   - The helper `open_menu(file, offered)` of #2989 is now `open_menu_kept`.
   - The merge put a second `mod display_quality;` line in `egui_app/tests.rs`. That line is removed.
5. `crates/ui/src/viewport.rs`:
   - The fields of the two PRs stay.
   - The shader source adds `wide::WIDE_SHADER` and `shade_pass::WGSL`. No WGSL name is used two times.
   - The segment `set_overlay` of #2989 replaces the old vertex `set_overlay`. `set_shade` and `set_effects` stay.
   - The render `match` has each arm of the two PRs, in the `self.pipes.*` names of #2989.
   - `set_samples` also builds the shade pipelines again.

Sample count of the shade pipelines (`crates/ui/src/shade_pass.rs`):

- The ground shadow pipeline and the occluded face pipeline draw in the one 3D pass. They use its colour target (the MSAA target when MSAA is on) and its depth target. They have no target of their own.
- Thus the two pipelines use the sample count of the pass. `View3D::set_samples` builds them again (`ShadePass::rebuild`).
- A pipeline with a different sample count than its pass causes a wgpu validation error.
- New accessor: `View3D::shade_samples()`.
- The decision record has a new section, "Merge with #2958".
- New GPU test: `gpu_render::shade_msaa::set_samples_rebuilds_the_shade_pipelines_for_one_and_four_samples`. It sets 4 samples and then 1 sample, with the two shade passes on. It makes sure that the counts agree, that a frame renders without a validation error, and that the passes draw.

The three see-through edits of the first refresh stay. Each one reads `is_wireframe()`:

- `draw_list::plan_with`
- `shade_cache::collect`
- `display_menu::quality`

#2989 adds no face pass, shadow pass or occlusion pass in a wireframe mode.

Built on the self-hosted pr-test runner: run https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/44821891658 - job "test": success (trial merge with main, build, touched suites and clippy).

What changed since 615584eed:
- Two merges of main, each hand-resolved. I read both remerge-diffs.
  - `470246c58`: conflicts in `crates/ui/src/draw_list.rs`, `draw_list_tests.rs`, `egui_app/tests.rs`. The wireframe face choice was folded into the shared `faces` binding so main's `Pipe::FacesDepthOnly` path and the PR's GroundShadow path both stand; the shadow test was widened to cover both wireframe modes. Both sides kept.
  - `f8d4e8a4a`: conflicts in `view.rs`, `display_menu.rs`, `tests/display_quality.rs` (add/add), `state_view.rs`, `viewport.rs`. The add/add file became one file documenting #2834 and #2958 and imports both sides' items. `display_menu.rs` calls main's new `lines()` and keeps the PR's `quality()`. In `viewport.rs` the shader source now concatenates `wide::WIDE_SHADER` and `crate::shade_pass::WGSL`, and `ShadePass::new` takes the pass sample count - the two renderer changes were joined, not chosen between. Nothing from main was dropped.
- `02638abe4` is a test-only clippy fix: `chunks_exact(4).zip(...)` to `as_chunks::<4>().0.iter().zip(...)`. Same semantics: both forms drop a trailing partial pixel.

The body carries the before/after images: a Performance/Quality pair, a ground-shadow and an ambient-occlusion pair, the Display menu and the "Look at a work plane" result.
